entries.95c29e5c29e5aa3e: A business in Japan researching, developing, manufacturing and selling medical electronic equipment, with revenue from external customers of ¥145,141 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, the largest of the three reportable segments. The company and Nihon Kohden Tomioka Co., Ltd. handle research, development and manufacturing, and the company's 11 branch and sales offices handle sales. Amid a difficult operating environment for domestic medical institutions, negotiations for IT systems such as clinical information systems, as well as consumables and services, remained firm.

entries.e8b25b4b1617b9c6: A business in the United States and Canada researching, developing, manufacturing and selling medical electronic equipment, with revenue from external customers of ¥53,623 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. Local subsidiaries, including Defibtech for life-saving emergency medical equipment, Nihon Kohden Orange Med for ventilators and Adtech for intracranial electrodes, handle development and manufacturing, and Nihon Kohden America handles sales. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales of neurology product lines, ventilators and AEDs increased significantly, resulting in double-digit growth.
